title: Urgent appeal to identify suspect of racially aggravated rape in Wallsall
summary: Police release CCTV footage after man described as white and in his 30s attacked woman in her 20s in Park Hall area An urgent police appeal has been launched to identify a man believed to have raped a woman in a racially aggravated attack. West Midlands police were called to the Park Hall area of Walsall just after 7.15pm on Saturday after a woman was reported to be distressed in the street. Continue reading...
